requestBody.query: How much data does netflix use?

200.answer:
Netflix data usage varies by video quality:
- Standard definition (SD) uses about 1 GB per hour.
- High definition (HD) uses about 3 GB per hour.

snippets.text: When using Netflix, video quality directly affects data usage. Standard definition (SD) uses about 1 GB per hour; high definition (HD) uses about 3 GB per hour. Adjusting the data usage settings within your Netflix account is the easiest way to control the amount of data used while watching Netflix.
